messages:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout for release 2026.03.20-gamma -> canary strategy: 10% (10m) -> 50% (20m) -> 100%
deploy-bot: Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/deploys/backout-2026-03-gamma (read-only)
deploy-bot: Backout triggers preconfigured: error-rate increase >4% sustained for 3m, p95 latency >800ms for 5m, new 5xx class spikes, or consumer feature regression hits alert suite

marta: ACK. I'll watch errors + p95. I'll call abort on any sustained breach and coordinate pin.
ken: Confirming rollback commit to pin if needed: abc1234 -> rollback target abc122f. If we pin, we pin traffic and pin model version at the load balancer.
ryan: I'll keep an eye on infra autoscale and region routing. If we see GPU OOMs or queue depth rise >2k, start traffic drain for canary nodes.

sana: Quick Q — any DB migrations in this deploy?
marta: No schema migrations. Only model binary and config change (batch size tweak). Safe from migration rollback complexities.

elaine: Put these escape steps in thread so oncall can act quickly:
- quick pin: `redwoodctl release pin --release 2026.03.20-gamma --commit abc122f`
- rollback (fast): `redwoodctl rollout rollback --to abc122f --graceful 60s`
- full kill-switch (global): `/ops kill-switch release 2026.03.20-gamma` (requires two approvers)

ken: Add monitoring commands:
- check errors: `curl -s https://metrics.redwood.ai/query?m=errors|grep gamma`
- p95: `metrics-cli p95 --service inference --tag release=2026.03.20-gamma`

marta: Decision thresholds reiterated: if error-rate >4% AND trending up over 3m -> immediate pin + rollback prep. If only p95 spike but errors stable, hold at 10% and extend canary to 30m and investigate.

ryan: If we need to drain canary: `infractl drain --tag release=2026.03.20-gamma --zone us-west-2` then set traffic to previous release via router.

sana: Thanks — noted no DB work. I'll shadow user-facing metrics for customer-impact signals.

elaine: Ownership: marta lead for rollback decision, ken executes pin/rollback commands, ryan handles infra drain, sana monitors product signals. I'll be escalation contact if approvals needed.

marta: Rolling to 10% now. tagging incident channel for visibility: #incidents (FYI).

deploy-bot: Canary at 10% complete. Observing metrics for 10 minutes.

ken: Oncall standby. Ping me if we hit triggers or need two-approver for kill-switch.

marta: Not seeing errors so far. p95 ~210ms. Holding.

ryan: infra looks healthy; queue depth steady.

sana: No customer errors in NRT logs.

marta: Moving to 50% in 5m if no regressions.

deploy-bot: Starting to ramp to 50% now.

marta: If at 50% we see small error blip (<1%) but spike to p95 600ms -> keep at 50% and start debug run. Only abort if error criteria met.

elaine: Reminder: if we abort mid-ramp, do pin first then rollback. Pin prevents flapping.

marta: 50% reached. Metrics steady. Proceeding to 100% after final check window.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete to 100%.
